description: Read a document status, decisions, linked records and text. Select sections and follow continuation calls to read long reports or consolidated SFS statutes. For a committee report or interpellation, relatedSpeechesCall searches the speeches the source links to it (a resumed debate’s later segments can lack the link). SFS text is consolidated published text, not a point-in-time legal version.

documentId.description: Document ID from riksdag_search_documents or a member vote row, or an SFS YYYY:N identifier.

htmlLength.description: Source HTML page length in Unicode code points; default 8000.

htmlOffset.description: Source HTML offset in Unicode code points.

revision.description: Revision from a previous call; a changed record is rejected.

sectionLimit.description: Entries per selected array section; clamped to a maximum of 100.

sectionOffset.description: Entry offset for each selected array section.

sections.description: Sections to return. Omit for metadata, outline and first text page; [] returns only the outline.

textLength.description: Text page length in Unicode code points; default 8000.

textOffset.description: Text offset in Unicode code points.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: An identifier that passes the input pattern is not a valid ID after NFC normalization. `revision_changed`: The source record changed between calls. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: The status response contradicts the requested document ID. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Payload violates the wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: Source unavailable after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: Upstream queue is full. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: How to resolve a missing identifier.

chamberStatus.description: Authoritative chamber status property, when published.

designation.description: Published document designation, distinct from its ID.

publicationStatus.description: Publication status; separate from chamber decision status.

sourceTextUrl.description: Published source text-route link; not necessarily plain text.

systemDate.description: Source system timestamp at published precision.

versionKind.description: SFS published consolidation, not a point-in-time legal version.
